network_status.network: Eventi idrogeologici storici in Valle d'Aosta
network_status.summary_it: La cronologia regionale del nubifragio del 23 giugno 2002 distingue il Pont du Loup, abbattuto, dal ponte di Mesoncles, gravemente danneggiato; il record ARCUS identifica invece questo caso come crollo totale sul Maisoncle. Finché attraversamento e severità non sono riallineati alla fonte primaria, non viene associato alcun valore idrometrico.
network_status.summary_en: The regional chronology of the 23 June 2002 cloudburst distinguishes Pont du Loup, which was swept away, from the Mesoncles bridge, which was severely damaged; the ARCUS record instead identifies this case as a total collapse on the Maisoncle. No hydrometric value is associated until crossing identity and severity are reconciled with the primary source.

provenance.method: Manual extraction encoded in the ARCUS event-report curation registry

caveats: The cited source review is complete; no compatible tabulated bridge-section value is assigned.
ARCUS does not digitise plotted hydrographs into false-precision event peaks.
The encoded failure process remains separate from hydrometric evidence.
Rainfall is not converted into stage or discharge.
